svg.title: Emmaus — timeless scriptural concordance, V16
svg.desc: Original native SVG engraving for the P2 film field. Time passes through the opened interpretation of Scripture: a field of measured temporal cross-sections, 66 interrelated registers and local engraved hatching. Luke 24:27; 2 Peter 3:8; Psalm 16:2. No physical scroll, black hole, or imagery of God.
svg.metadata: Westside Design OS / ONE colors: paper #ded096 (CSS backdrop); ink #102a43; accent #a2872a. Experimental, not accepted. All graphic marks are paths; no raster, no gradients, no filters.
